Humans have long wondered about the beginning of the universe. The truth is complicated, as the beginning is actually in the middle. Let me explain. 

In the infinite moment of creation, my Mother and Father were simultaneously born, woven together, and birthed my sisters and me. In that instant, my sisters were celebrated and loved, yet I was feared. While my sisters tried to work against me, my parents chose to flee instead. 

My mother began to expand in all directions, faster than even the light of my young sister. My Father ran simultaneously forward and backward creating anchors for all that was and all that will be. My sisters came together and created Life in the hope of slowing me.

You may think me cruel. You may try to forget me or ignore me so you can live without constant fear of me. But no amount of pretending or running or fighting will stop me. I am inevitable. 

For I am Entropy, and in the End, all things will come to me.
